rules.description: Applicant must live in the UK
rules.reason_if_failed: You must live in the UK to apply for a National Insurance number

rules.description: Applicant must have the right to work in the UK
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have the right to work in the UK to get a National Insurance number

rules.description: Applicant must be working, looking for work, or have a job offer
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be working, looking for work, or have an offer to start work to apply for a National Insurance number

rules.description: Applicant must be at least 16 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 16 years old to apply for a National Insurance number. UK residents under 16 are automatically sent a NI number before their 16th birthday if Child Benefit was claimed.

rules.description: Applicant must not already have a National Insurance number
rules.reason_if_failed: Our records show you already have a National Insurance number. You do not need to apply for a new one.

edge_cases.action: Reject application. UK residents are automatically sent a NI number before their 16th birthday if Child Benefit was claimed for them.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is aged 16-19 and may already have a NI number from Child Benefit
edge_cases.action: Prompt to check if they already have a NI number before proceeding. Direct to find NI number service.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a biometric residence permit or eVisa
edge_cases.action: Prompt to check BRP card or UKVI account for existing NI number before applying.

edge_cases.description: Applicant cannot take or upload photos of identity documents
edge_cases.action: Application will proceed but may require postal verification or in-person appointment. Processing time extended to more than 4 weeks.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has no passport or national identity card
edge_cases.action: Route to in-person identity verification appointment. Contact helpline for guidance.
